articles.headline: Federal judge orders Pentagon to remove Anthropic supply-chain risk label
articles.summary: A court ruling removes a Pentagon designation that had labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, reducing a potential compliance and procurement obstacle for enterprises and government buyers. The decision matters for companies using frontier AI because it lowers immediate uncertainty around vendor approval and contract risk.

articles.headline: OpenAI issued warrants worth $5.5 billion in SB Energy, WSJ reports
articles.summary: The deal points to the continuing capital intensity of AI infrastructure and the way cloud, power, and energy assets are becoming strategic inputs for frontier AI. Business leaders should watch this trend because it can influence data-center economics, electricity demand, and the long-term cost of AI adoption.

articles.headline: Tech backlash intensifies as AI angst collides with social media fears
articles.summary: The article highlights rising political and public pressure around big tech, including a landmark settlement involving Meta. Businesses should note the growing regulatory and reputational risk around AI, data centers, and platform power, which can affect compliance costs and public-sector policy.
